item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, and they all point the same way: you choose how you read a situation. Before you react today, pause and ask whether you're projecting or assuming what others think. Notice the pattern, then respond with a little grace instead of habit. You can't control the day, but you can control the lens. Action: at midday, take one slow breath and ask, "Does this moment support the life I'm building?"
